def _l2_norm_fwd(
    x, eps=1e-6
):
    x_shape_og = x.shape
    x = x.reshape(-1, x.shape[-1])
    if x.stride(-1) != 1:
        x = x.contiguous()
    y = torch.empty_like(x)
    N = x.shape[-1]
    M = x.shape[0]
    MAX_FUSED_SIZE = 65536 // x.element_size()
    BLOCK_N = min(MAX_FUSED_SIZE, triton.next_power_of_2(N))
    if N > BLOCK_N:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "This layer norm doesn't support feature dim >= 64KB.")
    with torch.cuda.device(x.device.index):
        _l2_norm_fwd_1pass_kernel[(M,)](
            x,
            y,
            x.stride(0),
            N,
            eps,
            BLOCK_N,
        )
    return y.reshape(x_shape_og)

def typedIO (storage : Storage) (commuted : Bool) (X Y : RegionName)
    (stride N : Nat) (eps : ℝ) (B : Nat) : MaskedKernelIO₁ :=

    projection := typed_supported storage commuted X Y stride N eps B }

    (X Y : RegionName) (stride N : Nat) (eps : ℝ) (B : Nat)
    (_hB : 0 < B) (_hN : N ≤ B) :

  intro A hd hr hc pid hin hout hscratch xs s hp hu hx
  obtain ⟨t,he,hv,hf⟩ := l2_norm_fwd_1pass_kernel_correctness X Y stride N eps B
    A hd hr hc pid hin hout hscratch xs s hp hu hx
  refine ⟨t,?_,?_,hf⟩
  · exact (typed_flat_exec A storage commuted X Y stride N eps B (A.flattenState s)).trans he
  · intro i hi

    exact padded_formula N B eps xs i hi

def token_softmax_fwd(Logics, B_Start_Loc, B_Seqlen, Prob_Out, max_input_len):
    BLOCK_SIZE = triton.next_power_of_2(max_input_len)
    batch, head_num = B_Start_Loc.shape[0], Logics.shape[0]

        num_warps=num_warps,
        BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE,
    )
    return

def tokenSoftmaxIO (Logics B_Start_Loc B_Seqlen Prob_Out : RegionName)
    (stride_logic_h stride_logic_bs stride_prob_h stride_prob_bs
      BLOCK_SIZE : Nat) : MetaMasked2DKernelIO₁ where
  kernel := token_softmax_surface Logics B_Start_Loc B_Seqlen Prob_Out
    stride_logic_h stride_logic_bs stride_prob_h stride_prob_bs BLOCK_SIZE
  mbuf1 := B_Start_Loc
  mbuf2 := B_Seqlen
  inp := Logics
  out := Prob_Out
  B := BLOCK_SIZE
  mwin1 := fun pid₀ _ => pid₀
  mwin2 := fun pid₀ _ => pid₀
  read := fun _ pid₁ m₁ _ j =>
    pid₁ * stride_logic_h + (m₁ + j.val) * stride_logic_bs
  write := fun _ pid₁ m₁ _ j =>
    pid₁ * stride_prob_h + (m₁ + j.val) * stride_prob_bs
  mask := fun _ _ _ m₂ j => j.val < m₂
